english: Crafting Skills
World settings shared with everyone on this save when Gears is on the server. Each toggle turns restriction on or off for that crafting skill.
Armor
When Armor is enabled, armor and clothing are restricted by the player's Armor crafting skill.
Bows
When Bows is enabled, bow weapons are restricted by the player's Bows crafting skill.

Robotics

Workstations

Vehicles

Electrician

Medical
When Medical is enabled, medical consumables are restricted by the player's Medical crafting skill. Off by default.
Food
When Food is enabled, food and drink are restricted by the player's Food crafting skill. Off by default.
Client
Settings that apply only on this computer and are not synced to other players.
Debug
Logging options for this client only.
Debug Mode
When Debug Mode is enabled, Limit by Crafting Skill writes extra detail to the game log on this client.
